description: Land Title Settlement Department - Murugampola, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510305 (22/120091)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title claims and registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple notices calling for claims to specific land parcels in various districts, including detailed descriptions of cadastral maps, land locations, and the legal process for determining land ownership. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
